extracted.name: German Wiener Schnitzel
extracted.description: An authentic German wiener schnitzel recipe made with veal and simple breading.
instruction_lines: Cut the veal into steaks, about as thick as your finger. Dredge in flour. In a shallow dish, beat the eggs with 1 tablespoon oil, salt and pepper. Coat the veal with egg mixture, then with bread crumbs.
Heat 1/4 cup oil in a heavy skillet over medium heat. Fry veal until golden brown, about 5 minutes on each side.
